# search

Tenant-scoped Meilisearch. Because ILIKE is not search.

## README

# Search

Tenant-scoped full-text search (Meilisearch / in-memory adapter).

## What it shows

- `searchable` / `searchWeight` on fields
- Handler reads via `ctx.services.searchAdapter`
- `createLongTextField({ personal: "tenant", find: "fuzzy" })`: a long body is searchable, decrypted for the index (Meilisearch splits it into pieces)
- Trash list: `softDelete` entity, list with `onlyDeleted: true`, restore via `article:restore`
- `r.relation(article, "comments", { type: "hasMany", ..., searchable: true })`: a list search on the article also finds it through a matching comment, only for viewers the comment's detail handler admits, gated like a direct read of the comment

## Source

Feature entry point: `src/feature.ts`.

## Tests

Needs the Postgres from the repo root's `docker-compose.yml` (`docker compose up -d`); `TEST_DATABASE_URL` defaults to `postgresql://kumiko:kumiko@localhost:15432/kumiko_test`.

```bash
cd samples/recipes/search
bun test
```

```ts
// Search Sample — Integration Test
// Proves: searchable fields indexed via system hook, search returns matches

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { TestUsers } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { productFeature } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

const admin = TestUsers.admin;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [productFeature] });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

beforeEach(async () => {
  // Advance the dispatcher cursor past previous-test events so each test
  // starts with a clean horizon — same pattern as realtime-sse sample.
  await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();
  stack.events.reset();
});

describe("search indexing", () => {
  test("created product is findable via search", async () => {
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "shop:write:product:create",
      {
        name: "Wireless Mouse",
        brand: "Logitech",
        sku: "WM-001",
        category: "peripherals",
      },
      admin,
    );

    // Since D.4 search indexing runs as an async EventConsumer — drain the
    // dispatcher before asserting.
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();

    // Search via SearchAdapter directly
    const results = await stack.search.search("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "wireless", {
      filterType: "product",
    });
    expect(results.some((r) => r.entityType === "product")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("search via list handler returns matching rows", async () => {
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "shop:write:product:create",
      {
        name: "Mechanical Keyboard",
        brand: "Cherry",
        sku: "MK-002",
      },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();

    const list = await stack.http.queryOk<{ rows: Record<string, unknown>[] }>(
      "shop:query:product:list",
      { search: "mechanical" },
      admin,
    );

    expect(list.rows.some((r) => r["name"] === "Mechanical Keyboard")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("search by brand field", async () => {
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "shop:write:product:create",
      {
        name: "Budget Mouse",
        brand: "UniqueTestBrand",
        sku: "BM-003",
      },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();

    const results = await stack.search.search(
      "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      "UniqueTestBrand",
      { filterType: "product" },
    );
    expect(results.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test("non-searchable field not indexed", async () => {
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "shop:write:product:create",
      {
        name: "Hidden SKU Product",
        sku: "SECRET-SKU-999",
        category: "test",
      },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();

    // SKU is not searchable, should not find via SKU search
    const results = await stack.search.search(
      "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      "SECRET-SKU-999",
      { filterType: "product" },
    );
    expect(results).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

describe("longText find: fuzzy and the trash list", () => {
  type ArticleList = { rows: Record<string, unknown>[] };
  const listArticles = (payload: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    stack.http.queryOk<ArticleList>("shop:query:article:list", payload, admin);

  test("a word deep inside a long body is found, and a deleted article moves to the trash and back", async () => {
    const body = `${"filler ".repeat(5_000)}deepneedle`;
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      "shop:write:article:create",
      { title: "Handbook", body },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();
    expect((await listArticles({ search: "deepneedle" })).rows.map((r) => r["id"])).toEqual([
      created.id,
    ]);

    await stack.http.writeOk("shop:write:article:delete", { id: created.id }, admin);
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();
    expect((await listArticles({ search: "deepneedle" })).rows).toEqual([]);
    expect((await listArticles({})).rows.some((r) => r["id"] === created.id)).toBe(false);
    expect((await listArticles({ onlyDeleted: true })).rows.map((r) => r["id"])).toEqual([
      created.id,
    ]);

    await stack.http.writeOk("shop:write:article:restore", { id: created.id }, admin);
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();
    expect((await listArticles({ onlyDeleted: true })).rows).toEqual([]);
    expect((await listArticles({ search: "deepneedle" })).rows.map((r) => r["id"])).toEqual([
      created.id,
    ]);
  });
});

describe("searchable hasMany relation", () => {
  const listArticleIds = async (search: string) =>
    (
      await stack.http.queryOk<{ rows: Record<string, unknown>[] }>(
        "shop:query:article:list",
        { search },
        admin,
      )
    ).rows.map((r) => r["id"]);

  test("a list search finds the parent through a matching child row", async () => {
    const article = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      "shop:write:article:create",
      { title: "Quarterly report", body: "numbers" },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "shop:write:comment:create",
      { articleId: article.id, text: "zebracomment needs a source" },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.eventDispatcher?.runOnce();

    expect(await listArticleIds("zebracomment")).toEqual([article.id]);
    expect(await listArticleIds("nomatchanywhere")).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Search Sample
// Shows: searchable fields, searchWeight, search via InMemory SearchAdapter, a longText field
// with find: "fuzzy" (chunked in Meilisearch) and a trash list (onlyDeleted) for restore.
// Each handler builds its executor inline so `ctx.services.searchAdapter` is read fresh
// per call — tests swap the adapter between runs.

import { buildEntityTable, createEventStoreExecutor } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import {
  createEntity,
  createLongTextField,
  createReferenceField,
  createTextField,
  defineEntityCreateHandler,
  defineEntityDeleteHandler,
  defineEntityDetailHandler,
  defineEntityListHandler,
  defineEntityRestoreHandler,
  defineFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { z } from "zod";

export const productEntity = createEntity({
  name: "product",
  table: "read_sample_products",
  fields: {
    name: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      required: true,
      searchable: true,
    }),
    brand: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", searchable: true }),
    sku: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    category: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
  },
  searchWeight: 10,
});

// A long body is searched like any text field; softDelete gives the trash list and restore.
export const articleEntity = createEntity({
  name: "article",
  table: "read_sample_articles",
  softDelete: true,
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    body: createLongTextField({ personal: "tenant", find: "fuzzy" }),
  },
});

// A searchable hasMany relation lets a list search on the article also find it through its comments.
export const commentEntity = createEntity({
  name: "comment",
  table: "read_sample_article_comments",
  fields: {
    articleId: createReferenceField({
      entity: "article",
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_system_identifier",
      required: true,
    }),
    text: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      required: true,
      searchable: true,
    }),
  },
});

const productTable = buildEntityTable(productEntity);

export const productFeature = defineFeature("shop", (r) => {
  r.entity(productEntity);
  const article = r.entity(articleEntity);
  r.entity(commentEntity);
  r.relation({
    entity: article,
    name: "comments",
    type: "hasMany",
    target: "comment",
    foreignKey: "articleId",
    searchable: true,
  });

  const articleAccess = { access: { roles: ["Admin"] } };
  r.writeHandler(defineEntityCreateHandler("article", articleEntity, articleAccess));
  r.writeHandler(defineEntityDeleteHandler("article", articleEntity, articleAccess));
  r.writeHandler(defineEntityRestoreHandler("article", articleEntity, articleAccess));
  r.queryHandler(defineEntityListHandler("article", articleEntity, articleAccess));
  r.writeHandler(defineEntityCreateHandler("comment", commentEntity, articleAccess));
  r.queryHandler(defineEntityDetailHandler("comment", commentEntity, articleAccess));

  r.writeHandler({
    name: "product:create",
    schema: z.object({
      name: z.string().min(1),
      brand: z.string().optional(),
      sku: z.string().min(1),
      category: z.string().optional(),
    }),
    handler: async (event, ctx) => {
      const crud = createEventStoreExecutor(productTable, productEntity, {
        searchAdapter: ctx.services.searchAdapter,
        entityName: "product",
      });
      return crud.create(event.payload, event.user, ctx.db);
    },
    access: { roles: ["Admin"] },
  });

  r.queryHandler({
    name: "product:list",
    schema: z.object({
      search: z.string().optional(),
      limit: z.number().optional(),
    }),
    handler: async (query, ctx) => {
      const crud = createEventStoreExecutor(productTable, productEntity, {
        searchAdapter: ctx.services.searchAdapter,
        entityName: "product",
      });
      return crud.list(query.payload, query.user, ctx.db);
    },
    access: {
      openToAll: {
        reason:
          "any signed-in user may search and list products in this recipe; creating " +
          "a product still requires the Admin role above",
      },
    },
  });
});
```
